badges.name: Alle mod mig
badges.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single premium cartoon 3D Christmas achievement badge icon, cohesive compact square silhouette, genuinely transparent background, generous safe margins. Match reference glossy red green gold objects, soft plush lavender-grey Miv cat with huge amber eyes and pink nose. Reference is style and cat identity only. No title, no watermark, no outer medal frame or background panel. Exactly ONE overwhelmed tearful Miv kitten wearing red snowflake scarf clutching its last wrapped Christmas present. FIVE clearly separate black-gloved thief hands reach toward the gift from around the kitten, each from a different direction; do not confuse hands with cat paws. Little integrated gift tag reads '5'. Fir and holly accents. Meaning: five different people have stolen your gifts. Cat has no eye mask. Keep composition readable at small size.
